Gideon, the first report was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, when you posted that the gate kiosks were offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant.

The channel only describes the guard at that point. Your 10:42 message says the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Nothing else in the channel describes the guard's activity until 11:03, when Mateo posted that the guard had checked in trailer 8836 after kiosk 1 came back. The channel doesn't cover 10:42 to 11:03 beyond that, so the postmortem may need the guard's account or the gate log for that window.
